newsitem.title: UK: Manchester United firm on UBS "buy" note.
newsitem.headline: Manchester United firm on UBS "buy" note.

text.p: Shares in Manchester United were higher on Wednesday, supported by a brokers "buy" note ahead of the club's soccer match tonight with Italian opponents Juventus.
By 1422 GMT, the shares were up 16-1/2p at 568-1/2p, with over a million shares traded.
Market sources said the shares had been supported by a UBS "buy" recommendation today.
The British Premiership champions and FA cup holders play the Italian club tonight in the Champions League at Old Trafford.
The British club is currently placed second behind Juventus in the same group of the competition and a win tonight could secure its place in the next round of the lucrative championship.
